```{python}
#Packages, nlps, and docs 
#Packages, nlps, and docs 
import spacy
import pandas as pd
from collections import Counter
from nltk.corpus import wordnet as wn
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import nltk

nltk.download('wordnet')

#language downloads
eng_nlp = spacy.load("en_core_web_sm")
spa_nlp = spacy.load("es_core_news_sm")
ita_nlp = spacy.load("it_core_news_sm")
fin_nlp = spacy.load("fi_core_news_sm")


```

```{python}
def read_book(path):
    with open(path, mode="r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
      return f.read()

#Open Books
eng = read_book("../data/english_alice.txt")
spa = read_book("../data/spanish_alice.txt")
ita = read_book("../data/italian_alice.txt")
fin = read_book("../data/finnish_alice.txt")

#Docs 
eng_doc = eng_nlp(eng)
spa_doc = spa_nlp(spa)
ita_doc = ita_nlp(ita)
fin_doc = ita_nlp(fin)
```

```{python}
#Lemma Variables
eng_lemmas = [(t.lemma_.lower(), t.pos_) for t in eng_doc
                  if not (t.is_stop or t.is_punct or t.is_space or t.like_num)]
spa_lemmas = [(t.lemma_.lower(), t.pos_) for t in spa_doc
                  if not (t.is_stop or t.is_punct or t.is_space or t.like_num)]
fin_lemmas = [(t.lemma_.lower(), t.pos_) for t in fin_doc
                  if not (t.is_stop or t.is_punct or t.is_space or t.like_num)]
ita_lemmas = [(t.lemma_.lower(), t.pos_) for t in ita_doc
                  if not (t.is_stop or t.is_punct or t.is_space or t.like_num)]
```

```{python}
# Finding verbs with Alice in spanish
import spacy

spa_doc = spa_nlp(spa)

spa_pairs = []
for tok in spa_doc:
    if tok.pos_ == "VERB":
        dobj = [c for c in tok.children if c.dep_ == "obj" and c.text.lower() == "alicia"]
        subj = [c for c in tok.children if c.dep_ == "subj" and c.text.lower() == "alicia"]
        if dobj or subj:
          spa_pairs.append((tok.lemma_, dobj[0].text or subj[0].text))
spa_pairs

#make a df

first_spa_verb = [item[0] for item in spa_pairs]

spa_verb_counts = Counter(first_spa_verb)

spa_verb_df = (
    pd.DataFrame(spa_verb_counts.items(), columns=["Verb", "Frequency"])
      .sort_values("Frequency", ascending=False)
)

spa_verb_df.head(5)

```

```{python}
#Finnish Alice Verbs
import spacy

fin_doc = fin_nlp(fin)

fin_pairs = []
for tok in fin_doc:
    if tok.pos_ == "VERB":
        dobj = [c for c in tok.children if c.dep_ == "obj" and c.text.lower() == "liisaa"]
        if dobj:
          fin_pairs.append((tok.lemma_, dobj[0].text))
fin_pairs

# df 

first_fin_verb = [item[0] for item in fin_pairs]

fin_verb_counts = Counter(first_fin_verb)

fin_verb_df = (
    pd.DataFrame(fin_verb_counts.items(), columns=["Verb", "Frequency"])
      .sort_values("Frequency", ascending=False)
)

fin_verb_df.head(5)
```

```{python}
#Spanish Adjectives finding

spa_doc = spa_nlp(spa)

spa_adj_pairs = []

for tok in spa_doc:
    if tok.text.lower() == "alicia":
        adjs = [c for c in tok.children if c.dep_ == "amod" and c.pos_ == "ADJ"]
        for adj in adjs:
            spa_adj_pairs.append((adj.lemma_, tok.text))


#df 

first_spa_adj = [item[0] for item in spa_adj_pairs]

spa_adj_counts = Counter(first_spa_adj)

spa_adj_df = (
    pd.DataFrame(spa_adj_counts.items(), columns=["Adj", "Frequency"])
      .sort_values("Frequency", ascending=False)
      .head(5)
)

spa_adj_df

```
